mechanism: Risperidone (D2 antagonist) directly opposes the dopaminergic effects of levodopa, reducing antiparkinsonian efficacy while increasing risk of extrapyramidal side effects and psychotic symptom breakthrough.
action: Monitor for reduced levodopa efficacy and worsening parkinsonian symptoms; consider alternative antipsychotics with lower D2 affinity (quetiapine, clozapine) if antipsychotic therapy is necessary in Parkinson's disease patients.
